title: Luxury Private Tour of Lake Louise, Moraine, Peyto & Banff
includes: Complimentary use of gear including hiking poles, sit pads, blankets, and headlamps.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the Canadian Rockies in comfort on a full-day luxury small-group tour with door-to-door pick-up from Canmore, Banff, or Lake Louise. Choose your own start time and ride aboard our premium Mercedes Sprinter van with a local expert as you discover must-see landmarks including Johnston Canyon, Morant’s Curve, Moraine Lake, Lake Louise, Bow Lake, and Peyto Lake. With stunning viewpoints, relaxed stops, complimentary gear, and a personalized pace, this tour is the perfect way to see the Rockies’ most iconic sights without the stress of planning, parking, or rushing.
